method: Compare all 861 unordered proposition pairs. Exact text uses trim plus lowercase only. Flag same speaker_name and intersecting half-open source locator spans through linked evidence; this is triage, not semantic equivalence.

review_decisions.decision: Prayer devotion and sacrifice devotion are different predicates.
Prayer exclusivity, sacrifice exclusivity and gratitude rationale are separate clauses.
Commendation and predecessor attribution are separate compiler acts.
Denial of literal sacrifice, specified actions, angelic prayer, general adornment maxim and prayer adornment application are different assertions within one report.
General ritual rule, individual reply/exception, Abu Burda explanation/question and narrated sequence differ by content or assertion mode.

limits: No candidate rows deleted or merged.
A shared source span is not independent corroboration.
Different-span or different-speaker semantic equivalence cannot be ruled out by this filter.
Full semantic duplicate clearance remains false; existing Arabic reviews explain identified cross-voice overlaps.
next_step: Validate reproducibility of pairwise triage and pin it with the Arabic review manifest; use findings to prepare bounded integration review while keeping unresolved voice/provenance holds.
